title: Render the animation
summary: Render settings for the final video: every quality option on (in Eevee full-quality reflections; here Cycles with denoise), motion blur for realism, Output 1920 x 1080 at 100 %, 24 frames per second, frames 1 to 150, FFmpeg video in an MP4 container with H.264 at a high quality, then Render > Render Animation.
expected_result: The 150-frame shot rendered as an MP4 video: the camera gliding from the mushroom across the grass to the pipe and the bomb in daylight.

steps.note: Render properties: everything on (the tutor's Eevee: full-quality reflections), Motion Blur on; Output: 1920 x 1080, 100 %
24 fps, frames 1-150; File Format FFmpeg, MPEG-4 container, H.264, Perceptually Lossless; Render > Render Animation
